description: Deterministic CloudSoft negotiation ending in non-binding agreement in principle at INR 48 lakh.

steps.label: Generate negotiation strategy
steps.reason: Prioritise budget fit, retain 99.9% uptime / 12-month term / DPA; liability to Legal if pushed.
steps.strategy_summary: Ask CloudSoft to meet the INR 48 lakh ceiling while keeping must-have SLA, term, and data-protection. Trade only payment terms if needed. Escalate liability to Legal — do not auto-accept.

steps.label: Draft opening buyer email
steps.reason: Opening ask against CloudSoft INR 50 lakh quote

email.subject: CloudSoft proposal — commercial and contractual clarifications
email.body:
Dear CloudSoft team,

Thank you for the proposal of INR 50,00,000 per year for PR-2026-1042.

Can you confirm whether you can meet our approved budget ceiling of INR 48,00,000 while retaining:
- 12-month initial term
- 99.9% uptime with measurable service credits
- Data-protection / DPA commitments
- Liability wording aligned to our playbook fallback

This message is a simulated negotiation draft for internal demo use only.

Regards,
ABC Technologies Procurement

action.rationale: Open on budget and must-have terms without conceding liability.

steps.label: Hold draft for human approval
steps.reason: Human must approve before simulator send

steps.label: Human approves opening email
steps.reason: Approved outbound message to mock supplier (no real email)

steps.label: Mock supplier counters at 49L
steps.reason: Persona offers modest price movement; holds liability firm

email.subject: Re: CloudSoft proposal — commercial and contractual clarifications
email.body:
Dear ABC Technologies,

We can move to INR 49,00,000 per year and accept the 12-month term and 99.9% uptime with service credits. We can confirm a DPA.

On liability, we propose to keep our standard cap language and would need to discuss any broader buyer-favourable wording separately.

Best regards,
CloudSoft (simulated)

steps.label: Analyze supplier reply
steps.reason: Price still above budget; SLA/term/DPA improved; liability unresolved → Legal if accepted

steps.label: Plan counteroffer
steps.reason: Counter toward target 47.5L; keep liability for Legal — do not auto-accept

action.rationale: Budget still exceeded at 49L. Counter at illustrative target 47.5L; escalate liability.

steps.label: Draft counter email
steps.reason: Counter on price; park liability for Legal

email.subject: Re: CloudSoft proposal — counter on commercial terms
email.body:
Dear CloudSoft team,

Thank you for confirming the 12-month term, 99.9% uptime with credits, and DPA.

Our approved ceiling remains INR 48,00,000. As a next step we can discuss INR 47,50,000 as an illustrative target for this demo, provided the must-have service terms remain.

Liability wording will be reviewed separately by our Legal team and is not accepted in this message.

Regards,
ABC Technologies Procurement

action.rationale: Move toward target price; do not concede liability.

steps.label: Supplier accepts 48L ceiling
steps.reason: Meets budget ceiling; liability remains for Legal offline

email.subject: Re: CloudSoft proposal — counter on commercial terms
email.body:
Dear ABC Technologies,

We can accept INR 48,00,000 per year with the confirmed 12-month term, 99.9% uptime, service credits, and DPA.

Please have your Legal team send mark-ups on liability; we will not treat liability as agreed in this thread.

CloudSoft (simulated)

steps.label: Analyze final commercial reply
steps.reason: Commercial must-haves met at budget; liability still open → escalate Legal separately but commercial AIP possible

steps.label: Next move: commercial agreement in principle
steps.reason: Recommend non-binding AIP on commercial terms; liability to Legal

action.rationale: Accept commercial package at INR 48 lakh; escalate liability to Legal.

steps.label: Close as agreement in principle
steps.reason: Commercial terms within policy; liability flagged for Legal — AIP is non-binding
